# Playground Blueprint schema

`playground-blueprint-schema.json` was retrieved from the official
[Playground schema endpoint](https://playground.wordpress.net/blueprint-schema.json)
on 2026-09-29. It is generated by the
[WordPress Playground project](https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-playground).

Keep this snapshot fixed for repeatable validation. When maintaining the
Playground integration, run `WPLAB_LIVE_SCHEMA=1 yarn test:integration` to
check upstream compatibility; review and replace the snapshot deliberately.
The optional live check needs the endpoint to accept the request. It does
not fall back silently if upstream is unavailable.
